description: This file contains Go source code defining error types, internal functions, and logic for validating the well-formedness of CBOR data items, including handling of indefinite lengths, nested structures, and specific CBOR types.

classes.name: SyntaxError
classes.description: Represents a CBOR syntax error with a message.

classes.name: SemanticError
classes.description: Represents a CBOR semantic error with a message.

classes.name: MaxNestedLevelError
classes.description: Indicates that the maximum allowed nesting level of CBOR structures has been exceeded.

classes.name: MaxArrayElementsError
classes.description: Indicates that the maximum number of elements in a CBOR array has been exceeded.

classes.name: MaxMapPairsError
classes.description: Indicates that the maximum number of key-value pairs in a CBOR map has been exceeded.

classes.name: IndefiniteLengthError
classes.description: Indicates that an indefinite length item was found where not allowed.

classes.name: TagsMdError
classes.description: Indicates that disallowed CBOR tags were found.

classes.name: ExtraneousDataError
classes.description: Indicates extraneous data following a well-formed CBOR data item.

methods.name: wellformed
methods.description: Checks whether the CBOR data item is well-formed, allowing or disallowing extraneous data.

methods.name: wellformedInternal
methods.description: Recursively checks data's well-formedness, returning maximum depth and error.

methods.name: wellformedHeadWithIndefiniteLengthFlag
methods.description: Reads the header of a CBOR data item, returning type, additional info, value, and indefinite length status.

methods.name: wellformedHead
methods.description: Reads the header of a CBOR data item, returning type, additional info, value, and error.

methods.name: acceptableFloat
methods.description: Checks if a floating-point value is acceptable based on decode settings.
